name: omp-opencode-bridge
description: Bridge OpenCode models/providers into OMP as a dynamic provider, plus external-plugin manifest validation and capability auditing.

omp.name: opencode-bridge
omp.description: Discover and use OpenCode models from OMP; audit external plugins.

enabled.description: Register the opencode provider on startup.

opencodePath.description: Path to the opencode executable. Auto-detected on PATH when unset.

server.description: Explicit OpenCode server URL (overrides `opencode service status` autodiscovery).

profilesFile.description: Path to a YAML profile configuration containing environment variable references only.

inference.description: Enable inference forwarding through OpenCode's session API (bounded capability; see README).

timeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout for OpenCode CLI/API calls.
